correctness.rationale: Generalized CRT shows conditional on S=N mod gcd(a,b), the residual quotient remainders for a,b are independent uniform with conditional means independent of S, hence covariance [gcd(a,b)^2-1]/12. Summing all covariances yields double gcd sum, Jordan divisor decomposition gives exact alternative. The summatory J_2(x)=x^3/(3 zeta(3))+O(x^2) combined with sum_{t}(2t-1)/t^3 produces stated cubic constant and O(m^2 log m) error; Chebyshev yields O_epsilon(m^-1) concentration about 1/4. Verified all 400 residue covariance pairs a,b<=20 and all formulas by independently computing complete periods m<=10. Infinite asymptotic follows actual summation not finite checks.

final_claim: For uniform N modulo L_m=lcm(1,...,m), modular energy E_m(N)=sum_{k<=m}(N mod k) has exact gcd/Jordan-totient variance and leading coefficient [(2 zeta(2)-zeta(3))/(36 zeta(3))]m^3, hence O_epsilon(m^{-1}) relative-deviation probability.
limitations: Equivalent covariance identity is classical and may have been applied to sums of residues in unindexed literature.
